def drive(me, enemy, arena):
    dx = enemy.x - me.x
    dy = enemy.y - me.y
    target_heading = degrees(atan2(dy, dx))
    diff = (target_heading - me.heading + 180.0) % 360.0 - 180.0

    # basic turn proportional control
    turn = max(-1.0, min(1.0, diff / 45.0))

    # avoid arena wall
    dist_center = hypot(me.x, me.y)
    wall_dist = arena.radius - dist_center
    if wall_dist < 1.0:
        # turn away from centre
        away_heading = degrees(atan2(-me.y, -me.x))
        diff_away = (away_heading - me.heading + 180.0) % 360.0 - 180.0
        turn = max(-1.0, min(1.0, diff_away / 30.0))

    base = 0.85
    left = base - turn
    right = base + turn
    left = max(-1.0, min(1.0, left))
    right = max(-1.0, min(1.0, right))
    return (left, right)

def weapons(me, enemy, arena):
    # spin up unless we are too close to the bubble
    dist_center = hypot(me.x, me.y)
    wall_dist = arena.radius - dist_center

def drive(me, enemy, arena):
    # vector to enemy
    dx = enemy.x - me.x
    dy = enemy.y - me.y
    target_heading = degrees(atan2(dy, dx))
    diff = (target_heading - me.heading + 180.0) % 360.0 - 180.0

    # proportional turn
    turn = max(-1.0, min(1.0, diff / 45.0))

    # wall avoidance
    dist_center = hypot(me.x, me.y)
    wall_dist = arena.radius - dist_center
    if wall_dist < 1.0:
        away_heading = degrees(atan2(-me.y, -me.x))
        diff_away = (away_heading - me.heading + 180.0) % 360.0 - 180.0
        turn = max(-1.0, min(1.0, diff_away / 30.0))

    base = 0.85
    left = base - turn
    right = base + turn
    left = max(-1.0, min(1.0, left))
    right = max(-1.0, min(1.0, right))
    return (left, right)

def weapons(me, enemy, arena):
    cmds = []

    # keep front spinner at max rpm unless too close to wall
    dist_center = hypot(me.x, me.y)
    wall_dist = arena.radius - dist_center
    if wall_dist < 0.8:
        target_rpm = 0
    else:

    cmds.append(spin("front", target_rpm))

        flipper = me.weapons.get("back")
        if flipper and flipper["type"] == "flipper" and flipper.get("ready", False):

def drive(me, enemy, arena):
    # vector to enemy
    dx = enemy.x - me.x
    dy = enemy.y - me.y
    target_heading = degrees(atan2(dy, dx))
    diff = (target_heading - me.heading + 180.0) % 360.0 - 180.0

    # proportional turn
    turn = max(-1.0, min(1.0, diff / 45.0))

    # wall avoidance
    dist_center = hypot(me.x, me.y)
    wall_dist = arena.radius - dist_center
    if wall_dist < 1.0:
        away_heading = degrees(atan2(-me.y, -me.x))
        diff_away = (away_heading - me.heading + 180.0) % 360.0 - 180.0
        turn = max(-1.0, min(1.0, diff_away / 30.0))

    # distance to enemy
    dist = hypot(dx, dy)

    # throttle: full when far, ease off when very close to keep control
    if dist > 2.0:
        base = 0.9
    elif dist > 1.0:
        base = 0.7
    else:
        base = 0.4

    left = base - turn
    right = base + turn
    left = max(-1.0, min(1.0, left))
    right = max(-1.0, min(1.0, right))
    return (left, right)

def weapons(me, enemy, arena):
    cmds = []

    # keep front spinner at max rpm unless too close to wall
    dist_center = hypot(me.x, me.y)
    wall_dist = arena.radius - dist_center
    if wall_dist < 0.8:
        target_rpm = 0
    else:
        target_rpm = 3000
    cmds.append(spin("front", target_rpm))

    # use flipper offensively when enemy is close and flipper ready
    dist = hypot(enemy.x - me.x, enemy.y - me.y)
    flipper = me.weapons.get("back")
    if flipper and flipper["type"] == "flipper" and flipper.get("ready", False):
        if dist < 1.2:
            cmds.append(flip("back"))

    # self‑right if upside down and flipper ready
    if me.inverted and not me.righting:
        if flipper and flipper["type"] == "flipper" and flipper.get("ready", False):
            cmds.append(self_right())

    return cmds
